answer_1.quote: We propose the Extract Excelsior and Expand framework (Ex³) to automatically construct storyline by learning from raw novels, and generate new novels that imitate the linguistic style of a specific genre.

answer_2.quote: automation metrics are as follows: • Self-BERTscore: Calculate the BERTscore between each adjacent pair of sentences within the novel... • Generation Perplexity: Average perplexity of all sentences... • Distinct Ratio: Percentage of overall vocabulary to the number of tokens... • Protagonist Ratio: Ratio of roles in the novel that appear more than a specific threshold...

answer_4.quote: We recruit 20 graduate students through an open channel within the university for human study.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are shown a premise and two corresponding novels, and asked to assess which novel is better on metrics such as relevance, coherence, event, diction, transition, interestingness, and human-likeness through pairwise comparison.
